text:
Maya K: Heads-up: aiming to publish Adaptive Routing announcement Wed Mar 25 09:15 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs, short benchmark stat for the blog, and inbound lead routing for the webinar signups. @Arjun @Sophie can you confirm?

Arjun S: Docs preview live: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/91 — ready for final editorial pass. Canary plan: 08:45 PT start at 5% in us-west-2, 50% by 09:20, full by 10:30. I'll notify #eng-oncall at kickoff.

Sophie L: Webinar landing draft: https://marketing.redwood.ai/webinars/adaptive-routing-v2 — CTA needs tightening. For leads, prefer Intercom webhook so SDRs get session context. I need the payload fields and a sample.

Nina M: Benchmark quick line: "In internal tests, Adaptive Routing reduced median token latency by ~20% and cut per-request infra cost by ~16% on mixed chat workloads." Can tweak if you want different framing.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout 1769955600 initiated by @arjuns  status: queued.

Maya K: Good. Marketing will hold publish at 09:15 PT (short buffer) and push social at 09:35 PT. Sophie  can you confirm Intercom fields?

Sophie L: Need: email, org, plan, signup_source, webinar_id, page_referrer, utm_campaign. Arjun  can eng emit those?

Arjun S: Yep will emit those fields. I'll DM the sample payload and webhook URL. Also note: KV cache warming may show 1-2s cold-start in some regions, call out in docs.

Maya K: Rollback question — if canary spikes, what's the trigger?

Nina M: Auto-rollback: >20% error rate for 3m triggers revert. Manual abort possible. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-rollback.

Maya K: Perfect. Marketing will finalize copy and share here by EOD. Will schedule the webinar for Apr 1 10:00 PT. :party-popper:
